messages:
maria_ae: Quick sync — HelioBank PoC is blocked on two items: customer CISO needs explicit KMS/HSM attestation + a hard pricing cap for the pilot. Can we get an exec touchpoint today? @luke_vp_sales
pradeep_se: I saw the ticket. I can provide the VPC + allowlist config. Main gap is their ask for a throughput SLO + a daily spend cap for pilot (they want predictability).
luke_vp_sales: I can join an exec call at 4pm PT. Do we have a concise cost estimate for a 7-day pilot at ~500k tokens/day? Also need a 1-page summary for their CFO.
maya_security: From security: two viable KMS paths — BYOK with HSM attestation or Redwood-managed keys with HSM-backed KMS. They explicitly asked to see SOC2 + HSM attestation. I can prepare a redacted attestation doc and a 1-slide summary.
maria_ae: Jonah, procurement expects a KMS addendum draft by EOD. Can legal expedite?
jonah_legal: I can draft an addendum template today. Need confirmation on data flow (do we keep request logs? any telemetry leaving their VPC?). Send me the minimal constraints to lock language.
pradeep_se: For throughput: on Dedicated1 with pre-warm we can deliver ~1200 rps sustained for short bursts. Quick pilot cost sketch:

```
Pilot estimate (500k tokens/day):
- Dedicated1 prewarm: $2,400/day
- Tokens: 500k/day @ $0.0004/token = $200/day
- OSS infra / egress misc: ~$50/day
- Total est: $2,650/day (one-off prewarm can be amortized)
```

pradeep_se: If we want cheaper, fallback to Hosted with burst credits + cached prefixes reduces cost but increases variance on latency.
luke_vp_sales: That dedicated number is above what their CFO hinted. We should present two options (Guaranteed Dedicated SLO vs Shared Hosted discount) with clear pros/cons.
maria_ae: Drafted a short email for the exec touchpoint, please tweak before I send:

"> Hi [Customer Exec], can we do a 30m call today to align on pilot commercials, KMS path, and timing? Proposed 4pm PT. Agenda: 1) SLO & throughput 2) KMS attestation option (BYOK vs Redwood HSM) 3) Pilot pricing and commitment 4) Contract timeline.

maria_ae: Can @luke_vp_sales @maya_security @pradeep_se @jonah_legal join?
luke_vp_sales: I'll lead. Maya — can you bring the SOC2 redacted + KMS slide? Pradeep — bring the prewarm numbers and fallback plan. Jonah — have the addendum draft ready for quick review.
maya_security: On it. I'll upload the redacted attestation and a one-slide summary before 3pm.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite sent to all attendees — https://calendar.redwood.example/meet/helio-poc-12345 (auto-note)
pradeep_se: Also flag: if we do VPC peering there's an added 6-8ms latency; sharing that with customer helps set expectations.
maria_ae: Action items: 1) Jonah to draft KMS addendum (EOD) 2) Maya to prepare attestation slide (by 3pm) 3) Pradeep to prepare prewarm numbers + fallback option 4) Luke to lead exec call (4pm PT). I'll send the invite now.
jonah_legal: Draft started, will drop into the thread for review in 2 hours.
luke_vp_sales: If execs ask for committed discounts after call I'll open a pricing-ops escalation. Heads up — that process takes ~24-48h for approval.
maria_ae: Customer asked: "can we get demo env by tomorrow?" I'm going to push for EOW but prepping materials in case they insist.
pradeep_se: Noted — prepping the demo env checklist and the fallback config.
maria_ae: Thanks everyone — please ping here when docs are uploaded so I can attach to the invite."
